connections.why: Recording from observation and sources provides the evidence that developing ideas builds on
Ideas are refined by experimenting with media, techniques and processes
Sustained refinement leads to a resolved, personal final outcome
The personal response must connect clearly back to the ideas first developed
The personal investigation is where AO1 development is sustained and evidenced
The written personal study and practical work both depend on critical recording and research
The personal investigation culminates in a resolved personal outcome
Preparatory study directly informs the supervised final outcome in the ESA
Working methods built in the personal investigation are reapplied in ESA preparation
Fine art is one route through which the broad 'art, craft and design' title can be answered
Graphic communication is one of the specialist titles within art, craft and design
Textile design is one of the specialist titles within art, craft and design
Three-dimensional design is one of the specialist titles within art, craft and design
Photography is one of the specialist titles within art, craft and design
Observational and critical recording underpins development whatever specialist title is chosen
